cards.title: Cleaving Blow
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Make a Dwarf strength +2 and damage +1.  Discard a Shadow item borne by a minion that Dwarf is skirmishing.
cards.lore: The shoddy workmanship of Orc-smiths cannot withstand the fury of Durin's folk.

cards.title: Dwarf Guard
cards.gameText: To play, spot a Dwarf.
cards.lore: Dwarves from Dáin's people are stout companions, trustworthy and loyal.

cards.title: Dwarven Axe
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a Dwarf. Each time a minion loses a skirmish to bearer, you may make a minion strength -1 until the regroup phase. The Shadow player may discard 2 cards from the bottom of their draw deck to prevent this.
cards.lore: “‘Buckler and corslet, axe and sword / And shining spears were laid in hoard.'”

cards.title: Farin
cards.subtitle: Dwarven Emissary
cards.gameText: To play, spot a Dwarf. While skirmishing an Orc, Farin is strength +2.
cards.lore: Among the envoys sent to represent the Dwarves of Erebor at the Council of Elrond was Farin, a young but wise Dwarf, and a fierce foe in battle.

cards.title: Gimli
cards.subtitle: Dwarf of Erebor
cards.gameText: Damage +1. Fellowship: If the twilight pool has fewer than 2 twilight tokens, add (2) and place a card from hand beneath your draw deck to draw a card.
cards.lore: “Gimli now walked ahead by the wizard's side, so eager was he to come to Moria.”

cards.title: Gimli's Helm
cards.gameText: Bearer must be Gimli. He takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish phase. Skirmish: Discard Gimli's Helm to make Gimli unable to take wounds.
cards.lore: A helm fashioned under the Lonely Mountain protects the head of Gimli the Dwarf.

cards.title: Greatest Kingdom of My People
cards.gameText: Tale. To play, exert a Dwarf. The first time your opponent plays an Orc each turn, you may take a [DWARVEN] card into hand from your discard pile. The Shadow player may discard the bottom 2 cards of their draw deck to prevent this.
cards.lore: “‘With golden roof and silver floor / And runes of power upon the door.'”

cards.title: Grimir
cards.subtitle: Dwarven Elder
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Spot a [DWARVEN] companion and exert Grimir twice to play a [DWARVEN] skirmish event from your discard pile, then remove it from the game.
cards.lore: Old and grey after many years spent in exile before the Lonely Mountain was reclaimed, Grimir can still wield his axe with strength.

cards.title: Nobody Tosses a Dwarf
cards.gameText: If a Dwarf wins a skirmish, discard a Shadow card. Its owner may discard 3 cards from the bottom of their draw deck to prevent this.
cards.lore: “‘My folk have never had dealings with any of the servants of the Enemy.'”

cards.title: Still Draws Breath
cards.gameText: Tale.\Each time a Dwarf wins a skirmish, you may discard a card from hand to heal that Dwarf.
cards.lore: “When thirteen had fallen the rest fled shrieking, leaving the defenders unharmed....”

cards.title: Ancient Enmity
cards.gameText: Make an Elf strength +1. If a minion loses this skirmish to that Elf, you may heal an Elf; any shadow player may discard a card from hand to prevent this.
cards.lore: Hard and bitter is the Elven hatred of Orcs, for they have lost many kinsmen to Orc savagery.

cards.title: Curse Their Foul Feet!
cards.gameText: Exert an Elf to reveal 4 cards at random from an opponent's hand. Make the fellowship archery total +X until the regroup phase, where X is the number of Orcs revealed. That player may discard X cards from hand to prevent this.
cards.lore: “‘A strong company of Orcs has passed. They crossed the Nimrodel – curse their foul feet in its clean water!'”

cards.title: Elrond
cards.subtitle: Lord of Rivendell
cards.gameText: To play, spot Gandalf or an Elf. At the start of each of your turns, heal up to 3 allies whose home is site 3. Fellowship: Exert Elrond twice (or once if you can spot 2 other [Elven] allies) to draw a card.
cards.lore: “He was the Lord of Rivendell and mighty among both Elves and Men.”

cards.title: Far-seeing Eyes
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Each time you play an Elf, draw a card. Any Shadow player may discard a card from hand to prevent this.
cards.lore: Keen Elven eyes see farther and more clearly than those of Men or Dwarves.

cards.title: Foul Creation
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Exert an Elf to reveal an opponent's hand. If an [isengard] minion was revealed, you may draw 2 cards.
cards.lore: Saruman's Uruk-hai mirrored the singular focus of their master, viewing with contempt and disgust all they encountered.

cards.title: Galadriel
cards.subtitle: Lady of Light
cards.gameText: At the start of each of your turns, heal up to 3 allies whose home is site 6. Fellowship: Exert Galadriel to play an Elf; that Elf's twilight cost is -1.
cards.lore: “Very tall they were, and the Lady no less tall than the Lord; and they were grave and beautiful... and the hair of the Lady was of deep gold....”

cards.title: Haldir
cards.subtitle: Elf of the Golden Wood
cards.gameText:
To play, spot an Elf.
While Haldir is at a forest or river (or any site 6, 7, or 8), he is strength +2 and an archer.
cards.lore: “‘But there are some of us still who go abroad for the gathering of news and the watching of our enemies.... I am one. Haldir is my name.'”

cards.title: Legolas
cards.subtitle: Greenleaf
cards.gameText: Archer. Archery: Exert Legolas to wound a minion. Exert him again unless he bears a ranged weapon or you can spot more minions than companions.
cards.lore: “‘And I too will go with him,' said Legolas. ‘It would be faithless now to say farewell.'”

cards.title: Lórien Elf
cards.gameText: To play, spot an Elf.
cards.lore: “‘...we dwell now in the heart of the forest, and do not willingly have dealings with any other folk.'”

cards.title: The Mirror of Galadriel
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Each Elf ally whose home is site 6 is strength +1. Maneuver: Exert Galadriel to reveal 3 cards at random from an opponent's hand.  Place one on top of that player's draw deck.
cards.lore: “‘What you will see I cannot tell....'”

cards.title: Shoulder to Shoulder
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Fellowship: Add (1) and exert a Dwarf to heal an Elf, or add (1) and exert an Elf to heal a Dwarf.
cards.lore: “‘May it be a sign that though the world is now dark better days are at hand, and that friendship shall be renewed between our peoples.'”

cards.title: Stand Against Darkness
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Exert an Elf to wound a [SAURON] minion twice or discard a [SAURON] condition or possession.
cards.lore: “‘What power still remains lies with us, here in Imladris, or with Círdan at the Havens, or in Lórien. But have they the strength, have we here the strength to withstand the Enemy...?'”

cards.title: The White Arrows of Lórien
cards.gameText: Tale. Bearer must be an Elf companion. Archery: If bearer is an archer, exert bearer to exert a minion. An opponent may discard a card from hand to prevent this.
cards.lore: Straight and true, the arrows of the Golden Wood are known to leave a deadly mark.

cards.title: Barliman Butterbur
cards.subtitle: Prancing Pony Proprietor
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Exert Barliman Butterbur to take a spell into hand from your discard pile.
cards.lore: “‘You don't know much even about them, if you think old Barliman is stupid,' said Gandalf. ‘He is wise enough on his own ground.'”

cards.title: Ottar
cards.subtitle: Man of Laketown
cards.gameText: To play, spot Gandalf. Fellowship: Exert Ottar and discard a card from hand to draw a card.
cards.lore: The Men of Laketown come from the North, where they trade with the Dwarves of the Lonely Mountain.

cards.title: Sleep, Caradhras
cards.gameText: Spell.\Exert Gandalf to discard a Shadow condition and then hinder all other conditions.
cards.lore: “‘Losto Caradhras, sedho, hodo, nuitho i ruith.'”

cards.title: A Wizard Is Never Late
cards.gameText: Play a Wizard or [GANDALF] ally from your draw deck.
cards.lore: “‘A wizard is never late, Frodo Baggins, nor is he early. He arrives precisely when he means to.'”

cards.title: Armor
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a Man or [GONDOR] companion. Bearer takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish phase.
cards.lore: “Then Elendil the Tall and his mighty sons, Isildur and Anárion, became great lords; and the North-realm they made in Arnor, and the South-realm in Gondor....”

cards.title: Boromir's Cloak
cards.gameText:
Bearer must be Boromir.
Maneuver: Exert Boromir to discard a weather condition.\Response: If a skirmish event or special ability is used during a skirmish involving Boromir, discard this to prevent that.
cards.lore: “He was cloaked and booted as if for a journey on horseback; and indeed though his garments were rich, and his cloak was lined with fur, they were stained with long travel.”

cards.title: Coat of Mail
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a Man or [GONDOR] companion. Bearer may not be overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled.
cards.lore: Soldiers of the White Tower have long appreciated the craftsmanship of the Gondorian metalsmiths.

cards.title: Great Shield
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a Man or [GONDOR] companion. The minion archery total is -1.
cards.lore: The Kingdom of Gondor has smiths much practiced in creating strong tools of war.

cards.title: No Stranger to the Shadows
cards.gameText: Stealth. Bearer must be a ranger. Each site's shadow number is -1.
cards.lore: “‘Ah, but you had not got me with you then,' laughed Strider. ‘My cuts, short or long, don't go wrong.'”

cards.title: Strength of Kings
cards.gameText: If a skirmish event is played during a skirmish involving a [GONDOR] companion, cancel that event.
cards.lore: “‘Believe not that in the land of Gondor the blood of Númenor is spent, nor all its pride and dignity forgotten.'”

cards.title: Hunt Them Down!
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Make an Uruk-hai fierce until the regroup phase.
cards.lore: “‘Do not stop until they are found!'”

cards.title: Saruman's Power
cards.gameText: Spell.\Exert an [isengard] minion to discard a Free Peoples condition and then hinder all other conditions.
cards.lore: The Uruks of Saruman are bred to be the instruments of his will, destroying his enemies with foul cruelty.

cards.title: Saruman's Snows
cards.gameText: Spell. Weather. To play, exert a [ISENGARD] minion. Plays on a site. No player may play skirmish events or use skirmish special abilities during skirmishes involving an [ISENGARD] minion at this site. Discard this condition at the end of the turn.
cards.lore: Saruman's spells can hinder even the wary.

cards.title: Savagery to Match Their Numbers
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Make an Uruk-hai strength +2. If you can spot 5 companions, also make it fierce and an additional strength +2 until the regroup phase.
cards.lore: Uruk-hai match their enemies' strength with their own feral rage.

cards.title: Traitor's Voice
cards.gameText: Search. To play, spot an [isengard] minion.\Regroup: Spot 4 [isengard] minions, an exhausted Ring-bearer, or 5 burdens to make the move limit for this turn -1 (limit once per phase).
cards.lore: “‘In all the long wars with the Dark Tower treason has ever been our greatest foe.'”

cards.title: Uruk Rager
cards.gameText: Damage +1. Each time this minion wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion or discard the top 3 cards of their draw deck.
cards.lore: A bloodthirsty bellow from a huge Uruk can win a skirmish before it begins.

cards.title: Uruk Shaman
cards.gameText: Damage +1. Maneuver: Remove (2) to heal an [ISENGARD] minion.
cards.lore: Uruk shamans know the arts of healing as well as those of battle.

cards.title: Uruk Soldier
cards.gameText: Damage +1. When you play this minion, exert a companion. The Free Peoples player may discard the top 2 cards of their draw deck to prevent this.
cards.lore: Saruman's Uruk-hai band together as an extremely effective fighting unit.

cards.title: Uruk-hai Armory
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. While you can spot an Uruk-hai, the fellowship archery total is -1. Shadow: Discard this condition to play an [ISENGARD] possession from your discard pile. Response: If your [ISENGARD] minion is about to take a wound, remove (1) and discard this condition to prevent that wound.
cards.lore: The ranks of Saruman's army include forgers of weapons and armour.

cards.title: Uruk-hai Raiding Party
cards.gameText: Damage +1. While you can spot 2 Uruk-hai, each Uruk-hai is strength +1. While you can spot 4 Uruk-hai, this minion is fierce.
cards.lore: “‘Imagine, Gandalf, an army – born from the earth of Isengard.'”

cards.title: Uruk-hai Sword
cards.gameText: Bearer must be an Uruk-hai. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion or discard the top 2 cards of their draw deck.
cards.lore: Their malevolent strength worsens the wounds from the gruesome weapons of the Uruks.

cards.title: Denizens Enraged
cards.gameText: Choose one: make a [moria] minion strength +2, or make a [moria] Orc strength +1 for each other [moria] minion you can spot (limit +5).
cards.lore: “...there came a great noise: a rolling Boom that seemed to come from depths far below, and to tremble in the stone at their feet.”

cards.title: Goblin Archer
cards.gameText: Archer.\The fellowship archery total is -1 for each [moria] archer you can spot.\Assignment: Exert this minion to prevent [moria] archers from being assigned to skirmishes.
cards.lore: “An arrow whistled over Frodo's head.”

cards.title: Goblin Patrol Troop
cards.lore: “As they ran they heard the beat and echo of many hurrying feet behind. A shrill yell went up: they had been seen. There was a ring and clash of steel.”
cards.gameText: Shadow: Exert this minion or a unique [MORIA] Orc to draw a card.

cards.title: Relics of Moria
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Remove (2) to play a [MORIA] possession from your discard pile.
cards.lore: “By both the doors they could now see that many bones were lying, and among them were broken swords and axe-heads, and cloven shields and helms.”

cards.title: Through the Misty Mountains
cards.gameText: Search. To play, exert a [MORIA] minion. Each time the fellowship moves to any site 4, 5, or 6 and contains a Dwarf or Elf, draw a card. The Free Peoples player may discard 1 card at random from hand to prevent this.
cards.lore: “‘One must tread the path that need chooses.'”

cards.title: The Pale Blade
cards.gameText: Bearer must be The Witch-king. He is damage +1. Each time The Witch-king wins a skirmish, you may exert him to discard a Free Peoples condition.
cards.lore: In his wretched grip, the Captain raised a Pale Sword.

cards.title: Úlairë Nertëa
cards.subtitle: Messenger of Dol Guldur
cards.gameText: When you play Ulaire Nertea, for each companion over 4, you may play a unique [RINGWRAITH] minion from your discard pile.
cards.lore: Some accepted Sauron's gift for glory and a notion of great deeds.

cards.title: Band of the Eye
cards.gameText: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may remove (2) to add 2 burdens. The Free Peoples player may discard 2 cards at random from hand to prevent this.
cards.lore: Far more Orcs has Sauron bred in the pits under Barad-dûr than Saruman could ever imagine.

cards.title: Desperate Measures
cards.gameText: Spot a [SAURON] Orc and remove a burden to take a [SAURON] card into hand from your discard pile. The Free Peoples player may discard the top 8 cards of their draw deck to prevent this.
cards.lore: “‘Go back, Sam. You can't swim. I'm going to Mordor alone.'”

cards.title: Forces of Mordor
cards.gameText: Shadow: Exert a [SAURON] minion to add (1) for each [SAURON] Orc you can spot (limit (3)).
cards.lore: “‘....the Dark Lord is not without allies. The Easterlings and Haradrim now pay tribute to Mordor.'”

cards.title: The Irresistible Shadow
cards.gameText: To play, exert a [SAURON] Orc. The Ring-bearer is strength +1 for each burden you can spot. If you cannot spot another companion, the Ring-bearer is resistance -2 for each burden you can spot.
cards.lore: “Once more the desire to slip on the Ring came over Frodo; but this time it was stronger than before.”

cards.title: Mordor Enraged
cards.gameText: To play, exert a [SAURON] minion. Plays on an archer companion. Each time the Free Peoples player uses an archery special ability, bearer must exert.
cards.lore: The armies of Elendil and Gil-galad inflamed Sauron's anger and hatred.

cards.title: The Number Must Be Few
cards.gameText: Search. While you can spot 7 companions, the move limit for this turn is -1 (to a minimum of 1). When you can no longer spot 7 companions or this card leaves play, this penalty is immediately lost.
cards.lore: “‘The number must be few, since your hope is in speed and secrecy.'”

cards.title: Orc Butchery
cards.gameText: If a companion is killed by a [SAURON] Orc, then for each card in the dead pile the Free Peoples player must choose to add a burden or discard 4 cards from the top of their draw deck.
cards.lore: For sport, Orcs hew cruelly at the bodies of those they slay.

cards.title: Orc Inquisitor
cards.gameText: When you play this minion, you may draw a card. The Free Peoples player may discard 1 card at random from hand to prevent this.
cards.lore: Cruel questioners of Mordor tore the secret from poor Gollum, that Sauron's most prized possession once again was found.

cards.title: Tower Lieutenant
cards.gameText: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may exhaust a companion (except the Ring-bearer). The Free Peoples player may discard 2 cards at random from hand to prevent this.
cards.lore: Sauron shows favour to those in his dungeons with the ambition to squeeze the information he needs from those caught spying out his borders.

cards.title: The Weight of a Legacy
cards.gameText: To play, exert a [SAURON] Orc. Plays on a [GONDOR] companion.  Limit 1 per bearer.  While you can spot 2 tales, bearer is strength -2.
cards.lore: “‘It is because of Men, the Ring survives.... I was there the day the strength of Men failed.'”

cards.title: Merry
cards.subtitle: From O'er the Brandywine
cards.gameText: While Merry bears a weapon, he is strength +2. Skirmish: Exert Merry to make him strength +1 for each hand weapon you can spot (limit +3).
cards.lore: “‘I don't know why he's so upset, it's only a few carrots... my point is, he's overreacting.'”

cards.title: Sam
cards.subtitle: Faithful Companion
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Exert Sam to take a [SHIRE] item into hand from your draw deck (limit once per turn). Response: If Frodo dies, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).
cards.lore: “‘Mr. Frodo's not going anywhere without me!'”

cards.title: Sam
cards.subtitle: Son of Hamfast
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Exert Sam and another companion to remove a burden. Then, exert Sam again unless you can spot 2 [SHIRE] allies (or Rosie Cotton). Response: If Frodo dies, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).
cards.lore: “‘Oh, I've never held a girl's hand before. I... I think I might just have myself another ale.'”

cards.title: Sting
cards.gameText: Bearer must be Frodo. Fellowship or Regroup: Exert Frodo to reveal 4 cards at random from an opponent's hand. Remove (1) for each Orc revealed (limit (2)).
cards.lore: “‘This is Sting.... Take it, if you like.'”

cards.title: A Talent for Not Being Seen
cards.gameText: Stealth. Bearer must be Merry or Pippin. Limit 1 per character. Each site's Shadow number is -1.
cards.lore: With their small size, Hobbits use any hole to hide in, and their trail is difficult to detect.

cards.title: Ettenmoors
cards.gameText: Plains. Skirmish: Exert your character (except an enduring character), to make it strength +2.

cards.title: Midgewater Moors
cards.gameText: Plains. Each time a minion is played, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion or discard a card from hand.

cards.title: Slopes of Amon Hen
cards.gameText: While you can spot more companions than minions, [ISENGARD] minions are twilight cost -1 for each [ISENGARD] minion you can spot.
